commits.message: Load archived Messenger conversations

Add ImportProfileOnboarding component for unified profile import process

- Introduced a new `ImportProfileOnboarding` component to streamline the onboarding process for various user roles by allowing resume and LinkedIn profile imports.
- Removed individual onboarding components for each role (Consultant, Bench Sales, Recruiter, Employer, Service Provider) to reduce redundancy and improve maintainability.
- Updated the main onboarding index to utilize the new component, enhancing the user experience by consolidating functionality into a single interface.
- Implemented file validation and API integration for resume parsing, ensuring a smooth upload and processing experience.
- Enhanced state management for file uploads and processing steps, providing clear feedback to users during the onboarding process.

Add backend specification for LinkedIn profile import during onboarding

- Introduced a comprehensive backend specification document detailing the onboarding process for Google/LinkedIn signup and LinkedIn profile import via Bright Data.
- Defined the end-to-end flow for user authentication, LinkedIn URL input, and profile scraping.
- Specified existing OAuth endpoints and introduced a new endpoint for scraping LinkedIn profiles, including validation rules and expected responses.
- Updated routing to ensure onboarding is accessible for both guests and authenticated users, facilitating a seamless profile import experience.
- Enhanced documentation to clarify the integration of LinkedIn profile data into the onboarding form.

feat(network): full spec redesign — My Network, Person Card, Find People, job-context panel, settings

My Network: nudge strip, quick filter chips (available/placed before/
gone quiet), role-dependent primary action (Submit vs Message), strength
pill + recency line, empty state routes to Find People instead of an
empty list.

Person Card: side sheet with identity, relationship summary, quick
actions, private notes with inline add.

Find People: trust-weighted directory search (verification badge leads,
never keyword-relevance-only), manual-connect fallback as a small text
link rather than a primary button.

Job-context network panel: "People in your network for this job" on the
job details page, matched against required skills/location, one-click
submit — the highest-value surface in the module.

Settings: two plain-language toggles in the existing Privacy &
Visibility page, wired to the real network settings endpoint.
